mapper.select: SELECT company_id, company_code, company_name, company_type AS user_type, reg_date, created_at, updated_at FROM TBL_COMPANY_INFO where 1=1 and company_type = #{userType}

SELECT J2.* FROM ( SELECT A.device_id, A.device_name, A.model_name, A.volte_num, A.keywords, A.company_id, B.company_code, A.car_num, A.update_date, A.maker_phone_1, A.maker_phone_2, A.reg_date, A.extra_info, A.created_by, A.updated_by, B.COMPANY_NAME, B.COMPANY_TYPE AS USER_TYPE FROM TBL_ROUTER_INFO A LEFT JOIN (select * from TBL_COMPANY_INFO) B ON A.COMPANY_ID=B.COMPANY_ID )J2 where 1=1
and J2.company_id = #{companyId}
and reg_date between #{sDate} and #{eDate}
and device_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchValue},'%')
and model_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchValue},'%')
and company_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchValue},'%')
and ( device_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchValue},'%') or model_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchValue},'%') or company_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchValue},'%') )
ORDER BY reg_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_ROUTER_INFO (device_id,device_name, model_name, volte_num, keywords, company_id, car_num, update_date, maker_phone_1, maker_phone_2, reg_date, extra_info, created_by) SELECT concat(C.company_code,'_',#{deviceName},DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s')), concat(C.company_code,'_',#{deviceName}), concat(#{modelName},'-',C.company_code,'_',#{deviceName}), #{volteNum}, #{keywords}, #{companyId}, #{carNum}, #{updateDate}, #{makerPhone1}, #{makerPhone2}, curdate(), #{extraInfo}, now() FROM TBL_COMPANY_INFO C WHERE C.company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_ROUTER_INFO R JOIN TBL_COMPANY_INFO C ON C.company_id = #{companyId} SET R.device_name = concat(C.company_code,'_',#{deviceName}), R.model_name = concat(#{modelName},'-',C.company_code,'_',#{deviceName}), R.volte_num = #{volteNum}, R.keywords = #{keywords}, R.company_id = #{companyId}, R.car_num = #{carNum}, R.update_date = #{updateDate}, R.maker_phone_1 = #{makerPhone1}, R.maker_phone_2 = #{makerPhone2}, R.extra_info = #{extraInfo}, R.updated_by = now() WHERE R.device_id = #{deviceId}
